notes: Read-only capture on a healthy running helper service (secondary venv /usr/blueos/venv2/bin/python3). CPU/RSS via tools/sample_resource.sh (--match helper/main.py, 60 samples, label running_baseline; PID 710 cmdline verified: /home/pi/services/helper/main.py). SLO via tools/probe_http.sh on GET /web_services, /check_internet_access, /hardware_id (--repeats 30); ping via GET /ping?host=1.1.1.1 (--repeats 30). check_internet_access uses @temporary_cache(timeout_seconds=5) so rapid repeats measure cached responses (~6ms); cold probes to external hosts are slower and variable. software_id not probed for SLO (journey not exercised). Raw evidence: /tmp/helper_sample.json, /tmp/helper_slo.json, /tmp/helper_ping_slo.json.

route_inventory.note: Confirmed routes on live Pi via /helper/v1.0/openapi.json; all read-only GETs.

running_baseline.note: GET contracts on a healthy running helper (idle, no mutating actions).

slo_running_baseline.note: check_internet_access latencies reflect 5s temporary_cache hits during rapid probing; cold external probes are slower/variable.

settings_mutations.note: helper has no settings manager or settings.json persistence (verified: no settings imports in main.py); nginx extension snippet writes are config side effects, not settings

platform_matrix.note: helper behavior is platform-independent (local port scan, UUID reads, internet probes); not captured across boards. Runtime captured on Navigator only.

state_machine: none — helper has no service-level lifecycle state machine; internet probe results and KNOWN_SERVICES cache are ephemeral request/periodic state (see service_definition states: Unknown)
